units.source_text: 走着走着，只见右手的工地上横放着几根五米多长的木材，就是在夜里看也呈现出明亮的木色。

en.t: As I walked on, I saw several pieces of timber more than five meters long lying across the construction site on my right, showing a bright wood color even in the night.

units.source_text: 走近工地，看见满地锯木子，恍如铺上了细碎的黄花，在越黑中飘逸着一股浓郁的木香。

en.t: When I approached the site, I saw sawdust covering the ground like a scattering of tiny yellow flowers, and in the deepening darkness a rich scent of wood drifted through the air.

units.source_text: 走到工地尽头的辘轳井的旁边，我本想从这里走到庙厨里，可转念又折了回来。

en.t: When I reached the well with the pulley at the end of the construction site, I had meant to go from there to the temple kitchen, but then I changed my mind and turned back.
